shots.narration: Your breakfast is still on somebody else's shoulder.

The porter wears precisely the rust jacket, grey waist sash, indigo headband and charcoal trousers of image 2. The tray holds three ordinary silver fish, not breakfast in a modern plate. Keep the THREE master's fish trays on the LEFT shop counter, the boat/cargo/ropes on the RIGHT, two lidded foreground quay baskets, awning and bridge in their actual locations if in frame. The carried tray is one incoming tray, not a missing counter tray. Adult substantial body, grounded walking stance, not a toddler. Sober BD clean outlines, matte flat colours, restrained textures and simple garment shadows. Perfect round oversized pure #FFFFFF head, black dot eyes, tiny straight mouth, no hair, nose, ears or brows; headband stays indigo. ALL skin #FFFFFF without shading, mitten hands without fingers. No text, extra people, children, enormous distant castle or fantasy tower.
